scope.cash: Existing financial ledger and acceptOrderPayment service. Ordinary order payment is available to all four staff roles unless explicitly denied, within branch and tenant access. Financial read, deposits, refunds, price overrides and reversal permissions are unchanged. No deletion endpoint or parallel ledger.
scope.channels: CASH is cash; KASPI/BANK_CARD/BANK_TRANSFER are noncash; other, unknown or absent methods remain uncategorized. Channel is derived from existing stable method codes; no payment-method data migration.
scope.shifts: Owner/director create, edit and cancel planned staff shifts. Employees read their own shifts. Branch timezone, assignee access, positive interval, overlap lock, idempotency, optimistic version checks and audit are enforced. Cancellation preserves history. No attendance or payroll.
scope.notifications: Read-only in-app current work queue: open tasks, scheduled fittings, remaining rental pickup and return work due within 24 hours or overdue. Managers see accessible branches; employees see their assignments. Existing entity permissions apply. Completion/cancellation removes an item on next read. Partial returns and resolved bulk losses are accounted for.

limitations: Notifications refresh on page open or explicit refresh, not background delivery. No unread receipts, push permissions, email, SMS, WA/TG or paid service.
Each notification source inspects at most 100 records in due-date order and shows an explicit limit notice with a full-section link. Pickup/return physical-state filtering follows that bound.
Cash date filters explicitly use UTC, matching the existing finance journal; row times show branch timezone.
No physical iPhone or Production verification. Browser checks use desktop Chrome and 390px mobile emulation.
The new staff_shifts migration is a local candidate only. It was applied only to a separate synthetic localhost database. Production adoption requires separate approval.
